name: Nomvula Dlamini
headline: Senior People Operations Manager
summary: Senior People Operations professional with 8 years of experience driving recruiting strategy, HRIS implementation, and people analytics initiatives across mid-size and scaling organisations. Skilled at partnering with leadership to build data-informed workforce plans, streamline onboarding, and improve retention through evidence-based HR practices.

responsibilities: Lead end-to-end recruiting strategy for technical and commercial roles across the organisation
Own the HRIS platform, ensuring accurate employee data and streamlined workflows
Build people analytics dashboards to track attrition, hiring velocity, and engagement trends
Partner with department heads on workforce planning and headcount forecasting
Manage a team of two HR coordinators and mentor junior recruiters
Supported recruiting cycles for operations and warehouse staff across three sites
Administered HRIS records and resolved employee data discrepancies
Generated monthly people analytics reports for regional leadership
Facilitated employee relations cases and performance improvement plans
Coordinated onboarding programs for new hires
Assisted with recruitment coordination including scheduling and candidate communication
Maintained employee records within the company HRIS system
Supported payroll input verification and benefits administration
Helped organise employee engagement surveys and compiled basic reports
